summary: Both phases delivered their stated objectives without violating excluded scope. Phase-01 correctly adds 'optional-touched' status, 'optionalInPhases' field, and updated schema; three unplanned integration test files were edited to satisfy the no-back-compat-shim policy (fixture required the new required field), and one optional file was touched without explicit mention in the handoff. Phase-02 correctly implements removeFrontmatterKeys, clearApproved, the extended transitionWriteSet condition, and the transitionArtifact reopen branch; one optional file (lineage.test.ts) was touched but the handoff inaccurately claims no file-plan deviations. All promised tests are present at their stated layers. Both commit subjects match the plan exactly.

Excluded scope respected: reconcile.ts, planOverlap/compute.ts, adjustPlan.ts, analyzePlanOverlap.ts, and reviewHandoff.ts all left untouched per handoff confirmation.

Three integration test files not in any planned or optional list were edited (tests/integration/adjustPlan.test.ts, adjustPlanCommand.test.ts, plansOverlapLanded.test.ts). Boundary contracts respected: GlobalFileEntry shape change is additive, schema/domain agreement enforced by pnpm test:type, consumers confirmed needing no edit.
Commit subject matches plan exactly: 'fix(reconciliation): classify touched optional files as optional-touched'. Body not independently verified (no Bash tool available to reviewer).

Handoff covers all required content but does not explicitly acknowledge tests/unit/globalReconciliation.test.ts (optional, touched in phase-01) in the deviation list — only the three integration tests are called out.

Objective fully delivered: removeFrontmatterKeys exists as a standalone operation (not a FrontmatterEdit variant), clearApproved delegates to it, transitionWriteSet condition matches plan verbatim, transitionArtifact reopen branch clears both the frontmatter stamp and the sidecar record before finalizeTransition.

All seven planned files edited. tests/unit/artifact/lineage.test.ts is optional in the plan, was touched, and is shown as 'unplanned' in the reconciliation table (pre-fix artefact). Within optional scope.

Handoff states 'No file-plan deviations: all planned files edited, no unplanned files touched' but tests/unit/artifact/lineage.test.ts (optional) was in fact touched. The implementation is correct; the handoff wording is imprecise.

All promised tests present: writeSet.test.ts has plan-Draft includes approvals, spec-Draft does not, plan-Stale does not (pinned arbitration); frontmatter.test.ts has 4 removeFrontmatterKeys cases (delete, no-op, missing-block, yaml-syntax); artifactStatus.test.ts has 3-case reopen suite (Stale→Draft drops stamp+record, Approved→Stale retains, reopen commit carries write-set and leaves clean tree); lineage.test.ts (optional) has 4 clearApproved cases including fingerprint-neutrality round-trip.

Boundary contracts respected: transitionWriteSet condition verbatim matches plan; clearApproved and removeApprovalRecord called together; spec-reopen guard proven by write-set unit test; auto-commit contract proven by integration test asserting clean working tree after reopen.
Commit subject matches plan exactly: 'fix(artifact): clear the approval when a plan is reopened'. Body not independently verified (no Bash tool available to reviewer).

Covers all required content: exact signatures and module paths for removeFrontmatterKeys and clearApproved, verbatim transitionWriteSet condition, spec-reopen confirmation, Approved→Stale retention confirmation with test proof, clean-tree assertion.

attentionPoints: Reconciliation table shows optional files (tests/unit/globalReconciliation.test.ts in phase-01, tests/unit/artifact/lineage.test.ts in phase-02) as 'unplanned' rather than 'optional-touched', despite phase-01 being specifically tasked with fixing this classification. If the table was generated after phase-01's commit, these entries should read 'optional-touched'. Investigate whether the reconciliation generator was invoked with the updated code, or whether there is a remaining bug in how optional file lists are threaded from the plan into the aggregator at run time.

Commit bodies for both phases were not independently verified by this review — no Bash tool was available to inspect git log output. Manual verification of both commit bodies against the plan's 'Commit body' sections is recommended before closing the run.
pointers: tests/unit/artifact/lineage.test.ts line 147 — the no-op case asserts `cleared.right === md` (referential equality). This passes when the key is absent, but may be worth confirming that the yaml parser does not re-emit the document when no changes are made, to avoid a spurious test pass if the equality check ever loosens.
